$description: Cotton Foundation brand tokens. Human source of truth: guidelines/colors.md, guidelines/typography.md, guidelines/components.md. Values were read from the old cottonfoundation.org Elementor kit and the supplied logo files on 2026-09-22 (see references/website-audit.md). Values marked provisional are pending the owner's answers in brand/decision-log.md.

legal-name.$description: Registered 501(c)(3), as stated in the old site's tax line. Confirm the exact legal name with the owner (decision log Q2).

flagship-program.$description: Owned and operated by Cotton Foundation.

mark.$value: Cotton boll held in two hands (assets/marks/cf-mark_full-color.svg)

brand-idea.$description: The recurring phrase of the brand (the mission statement, the old home-page headline). Not confirmed as an official tagline (decision log Q4).

navy.$description: Foundation Navy. Elementor kit primary. RGB 23/52/94. CMYK starting point 100/80/30/25. Pantone 534 C nearest (unverified). The supplied logo PNGs measure #16345E; the canonical value is the site kit value (decision D3).

cotton-gold.$description: Cotton Gold. The exact fill of the cotton boll in the 2026 logo files. RGB 159/118/43. CMYK starting point 30/50/95/15. Pantone 7557 C nearest (unverified). Mark color only; not a UI color.

harvest-gold.$description: Harvest Gold. Elementor kit secondary. RGB 160/116/0. CMYK starting point 30/50/100/15. Pantone 125 C / 7557 C region (unverified). Eyebrow labels, small accents, the SUBMIT and secondary CTA fills.

horizon-blue.$description: Horizon Blue. RGB 62/107/156. Pantone 7683 C nearest (unverified). Eyebrow labels on navy and photographic grounds (as built); statistic figures on light grounds.

signal-red.$description: Signal Red. RGB 189/32/46. Pantone 1797 C nearest (unverified). Defined in the site kit; reserved for form errors and alerts only. Never decorative.

hope-gold.$description: Hope Gold. RGB 224/166/0. Pantone 124 C nearest (unverified). The primary call-to-action fill (Learn More About Taylor's Place, Donate Now in the footer). Always with Ink text, never white text.

ink.$description: Ink. Elementor kit text color. RGB 23/33/46. Body and heading text on light grounds; text on Hope Gold buttons.

slate.$description: Slate. RGB 128/130/133. The Astra theme body-text default. 3.7:1 on white: fails WCAG AA for body text. Captions, metadata and disabled states only (decision log Q6).

silver.$description: Silver. RGB 177/177/194. Rules, borders, outline-button strokes on dark grounds, form field borders.

mist.$description: Mist. RGB 245/248/250. Alternate page section background (the Who We Are band).

cloud.$description: Cloud. RGB 243/243/243. Elementor kit light gray. Form field fills, subtle panels.

white.$description: White. The page ground; the mark and lockup reversed on navy and on photography.

black.$description: Utility only: engraving, laser, vinyl cut, forms.

display.$description: Headings, statistics, pull quotes. Google Fonts, SIL OFL. The site loads weights 300-700 with italics; headings use 700.

sans.$description: Body copy, navigation, buttons, eyebrows, forms. Google Fonts, SIL OFL. Weights 400 and 700 (600 is synthesized on the site's nav).

sans-alt.$description: Loaded by the site and set as the Elementor 'Text' and 'Accent' global fonts, but computed body text renders in PT Sans. Provisional; decision log Q5 decides whether the system keeps one sans or two.

heading-as-built.$description: The Astra default the site inherits. Too loose for Cormorant Garamond at display sizes.

aspect-ratio.$description: width / height of the trimmed mark artwork (8251 x 8219 px in the 8334 px original).

clear-space.$description: fraction of the mark's width, all sides

min-width-embroidery-mm.$description: Provisional; needs a sew-out. The boll's inner stems are fine detail.

horizontal-lockup.$description: Units where the mark width = 1000; y measured down from the mark's top edge. Measured from Cotton-Foundation-2026-01.png (5310 x 1703 px trimmed).

cotton-cap-height.$description: Measured extent of COTTON including the O overshoot; nominal cap height about 275.

cotton-letter-gap.$description: Average gap between letters of COTTON (50-70), about 21% of cap height.

foundation-letter-gap.$description: Uniform; about 80% of cap height. FOUNDATION is tracked out to the full width of COTTON.

line-gap.$description: COTTON baseline (537) to FOUNDATION cap top (668).

clear-space.$description: fraction of the mark's width, all sides (equal to about 250 units, roughly the COTTON cap height)

min-width-screen-px.$description: Below this FOUNDATION drops under 8 px cap height. Use the mark alone or the compact lockup from the design phase.

taylors-place.$description: The Taylor's Place mark exists only as built (gate sign, truck decal). No digital file was supplied. Proportions to be measured from the original artwork when supplied (decision log Q1).

web-content-max.$description: Measured content column at a 1316 px viewport; the effective grid the pages use.

shadow-header.$description: Recommended for the sticky header; the site's header has no shadow.

overlay-hero.$description: Navy overlay on hero and CTA photography, as observed (opacity approximate).
